tonight.headline: Taylor plays first tonight — Tuten's question waits for Friday
body: Bad news first: Tuten was limited Wednesday (ankle/foot) and is still QUESTIONABLE, and your bench has no back who plays after noon — Marks is out tonight and Jacobs is out and on bye. Rice and Odunze lock at 12:00, before Jacksonville's 13:55 inactives, so the decision is Friday's: doubtful or out → Gordon to RB, Rice to FLEX before noon.

Taylor kicks off your week tonight at 19:15 in Houston, with no designation but Indianapolis 12.5-point underdogs and McGowan taking about a dozen touches. ESPN projects 128.2 to 116.8 and gives you 56%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Lawrence (18.6), Parker Washington (15.3) and Skattebo (14.5) all play Jacksonville–New York at 15:25 — the same game as your Tuten and Likely (league file). A Jaguars shootout feeds both sides.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten inactive at 13:55 with Rice already locked — about 17 projected points to zero. The Friday rule is the fix.

case.body: Your bench is Rice (KC, 12:00), Odunze (CHI, 12:00), Golden (bye), Jacobs (out, bye) and Marks (out tonight, NFL.com). Tuten's inactives come at 13:55 — after every possible replacement has locked.

case.label: The rule
case.body: Friday's final Jaguars report: OUT or DOUBTFUL → before 12:00 Sunday move Ollie Gordon II to RB and start Rashee Rice (12.8, full practice Wednesday — Chiefs.com) in FLEX. QUESTIONABLE after a limited or full Friday → start Tuten (17.0); 4.2 points of projection is worth the risk.

case.label: Why not insure on the wire
case.body: Kaelon Black (SF, Sunday night, free agent) or Aaron Jones (MIN, Sunday night) would be live 13:55 fallbacks, but the seat would be Marks' (open thesis, nothing tripped) or Jacobs' (back 25 Nov). Not for a back who played through this last week.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: You keep Tuten on a questionable tag and he is inactive (zero from the slot), or you bench him on a doubtful tag and he plays and outscores Rice (archive).
